why: Hand decisions the migration cannot infer from the corpus. Kept deliberately
small: each entry is a content judgement, not a code workaround.
The migration applies these BEFORE it picks a canonical gloss per word id.

splitIds.why: 新 means 'new' in every other deck. In the plate deck the character stands for the province, which is a different word wearing the same Hanzi and the same pinyin.
贵 means 'expensive' elsewhere; here it abbreviates 贵州.
云 means 'cloud' in the Weather deck; here it abbreviates 云南.
